rejected_rule.statement: A creditor who proceeds to execution before other creditors can be given preference over them.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "This case is one in which a creditor has proceeded to execution and obtained judgment, but has not proceeded to execution. Held (in an application for concurrence by the appellants), that the eleventh respondent was entitled to preference."

meta.parties: Thornton Et Al. v. Emanuel Et Al
